title: Count the Vowels
statement:
Count how many vowels appear in a line of text.

The input is one line of text. It can contain letters, spaces, and punctuation, and it can be empty. Go through it one character at a time and print how many characters are vowels. The vowels are `a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, and `u`, in lowercase or uppercase. Print `0` when the line has no vowels, including when it is empty.

Input:

```text

```

Expected output:

```text
3
```
